families.sans: "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", -apple-system, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei UI", "Noto Sans SC", sans-serif
families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "Cascadia Mono", "Liberation Mono", ui-monospace, monospace

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps, helper lines, thread second line, table headers (weight 500 variant).
styles.sample: 上一轮中断了，打开会话点继续

styles.name: caption-strong
styles.usage: Group labels in menus and the command palette (a block title). Not for tags or counts, which are 400.

styles.name: control
styles.usage: Sidebar rows and read thread titles, menu items, inputs, field labels, table cells, pickers. The minimum size for anything clickable.

styles.name: control-strong
styles.usage: Button text, block titles (panel section heads), unread thread titles, the selected nav item. The only places weight 500 appears.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Message text and the composer. Line height is 1.6.
styles.sample: 我读了 3 个文件，改了 2 处。

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Dialog titles, empty-state headings, settings section titles.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Page titles. The largest size in the product.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Commands, paths, branch names, diff lines.

styles.name: code-sm
styles.usage: Code at 12: tool output blocks, a path, branch or ID inside a meta line. Not for numbers: counts, sizes, money, percentages and times are sans with tabular-nums (`.fa-num`), right-aligned in columns.
